authority: 33 section 4 item 6; P5b E and A5; public contracts from module owner

case_groups.expect: Only explicit synthetic intermediate schema accepted; unknown actual v3 shape is unsupported
Unknown or missing root and row fields rejected; strict booleans and integers
Foreign owner or subject in request, payload, current row or source is controlled without private text leakage
Payload revision and source epoch must equal current host snapshot
Raw content, role, source identity, original timestamp, thread and row revision cannot drift from current immutable row
Current source original quote and revision must still match; source flags and time are rechecked
Revoked, inactive, incognito, optout, secret and sensitive sources create no operations or readable samples
Raw original text, answers and timestamps remain unchanged and no fact is created
Assistant can inherit only an earlier same-thread valid user within six hours; no assistant-as-user assertion
Manual current labels are not overwritten; uncertainty remains waiting rather than daily
Plans and review previews have no apply capability, all batches require review, samples and titles at most 80 characters
Absent versus explicit null before values survive inverse operations field by field
Identical input and operation produce stable plan; changed operation input or plan ledger is rejected
Unknown, planned or mismatched applied ledger cannot authorize undo
Applied ledger, global revision and per-target revisions bind undo to exact host state
Undo never revives source revoked after planning, including when source epoch was not advanced
Undo cannot overwrite concurrent label changes, immutable source edits or later topic references
Undone operation replay yields no inverse operation and cannot be planned again
Tampered plan fingerprint or original payload cannot pass preview or undo checks
Repeated pure runs do not mutate raw export, host snapshot or original source text

limitations: No actual v3 exporter format has been verified
Host projections and operation ledgers are trusted inputs, not authentication proofs
No database, stage, real model, title-generation request or actual application/revert is exercised
This independent matrix does not assert classifier blind quality or inspect blind B
